Subject: Composite cost + latency tiles — per-route drill & export request

Hi team,

Looping you in on a product ask that came up in this morning sync with Acme (ops@acmeanalytics.com). They want a single Console tile that synthesizes per-route economics: a compact view that shows cost-per-1k-tokens, median and p95 latency, and a clear button to drill into tenant slices and export a reconciliation CSV for billing.

Top-level requirements (from Acme):
- A 1-line per-route row with: route name, 7d cost ($), 7d token count, median latency, p95 latency, anomaly flag if cost or p95 changed > 25%
- Ability to filter by tenant, model family, and region; save filters as dashboard presets
- Drill: click row -> time-series view (cost + p95) with token-path breakdown and top 10 callers
- Export: one-click CSV with raw aggregated rows (route, tenant, tokens, cost, median, p95, start/end) for given date window
- Reasonable query latency for the tile (< 3s for 30 routes) and an option to schedule nightly exports for finance

I've attached a quick spec (composite-tile-spec-v1.pdf) with a mockup and a sample-rate tradeoffs spreadsheet that Dylan asked for earlier. Questions for product/engineering:
1) Feasibility — can we surface aggregated p95s and cost in a single tile without pulling full traces for each tenant?
2) Telemetry retention/sample-rate implications — what's an acceptable sample policy to keep costs down but keep p95 accuracy within ~10%?
3) Permissions — can we tie the export to billing roles only?
4) Priority — Acme has an upcoming renewal conversation and would find value if we can ship an MVP before their EOW review (9/29).

Laura — can you help prioritize this against the Console roadmap?
Dylan — can you sketch feasibility and rough engineering estimate?
Ben — can you own the export schema and CSV contract for finance reconciliation?

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin

Thanks Marcus — good summary.

A few clarifying items before we scope:
- Is the anomaly flag intended to be purely stateless (compare rolling windows) or tied to alerting (pager/signal)?
- For "top 10 callers" do they mean top 10 tenant IDs by spend, or top 10 API clients (token path)? Let's ask Acme for an example export to confirm.
- Export cadence: nightly scheduled job vs on-demand CSV. Both are viable but engineering cost differs.

If this is material to the renewal, we can consider a scoped MVP: tile with aggregated metrics + on-demand export, leaving scheduled jobs for phase 2. That would reduce telemetry/backfill needs.

I'll add this to next week's Console planning (card + priority) and tag SUP-1209. Marcus — can you capture an example CSV that Acme expects and confirm the exact retention window they want in the export?

Subject: Re: Composite cost + latency tiles — per-route drill & export request

Quick feasibility notes after a short spike:
- Aggregation: we can compute cost-per-route and token counts from our billing aggregators; those are cheap. Median is trivial; p95 is heavier but can be maintained via approximate sketches (t-digest) at the route+tenant level.
- Sampling: to keep storage/query cost reasonable we should keep full telemetry for last 7 days at 100% and then apply event sampling for 30–90d lookbacks. For p95 accuracy within ~10% at route granularity, a 5–10% sample for older windows is realistic. See attached sample-rate-tradeoffs.xlsx.
- Query latency: a single tile that pulls 30 routes (with route-level t-digests) should return in <3s if we cache daily aggregates and compute recent minutes from a hot store. Real-time p95 (per-minute) will be heavier and likely >3s.
- Export: we can generate on-demand CSVs by joining daily aggregates with tenant mapping — very straightforward. Nightly scheduled exports require a small pipeline (1–2 days to implement) and infra to store blobs for 90 days.

Risks/notes:
- Permissioning: export must be gated by RBAC; we will rely on Console's billing-role mapping. Small UI work to expose the export button only to allowed roles.
- When users filter by many tenants, on-demand queries may exceed our query budget — recommend a hard cap (e.g., max 250 tenants per export) and a warning in the UI.

Next steps proposed:
- Phase 1 (MVP, 2 sprints): aggregated tile + on-demand CSV + drill to cached 7d time-series + RBAC gating.
- Phase 2 (after MVP): scheduled nightly exports, longer retention, and real-time minute-level p95.

I can put together a rough JIRA technical design and estimate (~6–8 dev days for MVP across infra + Console).

- For the export CSV, finance will want invoice-aligned windows (calendar months) and a mapping to our internal cost center tag. Can the CSV include a "customer_cost_center" column that we can populate with our tags?
- The anomaly flag should be visual for our SREs (not a pager) — a highlight on the tile with a hover tooltip that explains the delta and the baseline window.
- For the initial ship, on-demand export + 7d cached view is perfect. Nightly exports are nice-to-have.

I've attached an example file we use today (sample-export-example.csv) to show the shape of what finance expects. Happy to hop on a quick 30m call if that helps.
